title: Dependency Scanning
description: Continuously scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities.

data.text:
**Dependency Scanning**

Modern apps depend on dozens or hundreds of packages. Each one is a potential attack vector.

items: Log4Shell, EventStream, and others show supply-chain risk
GitHub Dependabot: automated PRs for updates
Snyk: deep vulnerability and license scanning
GitLab Container Scanning: built into pipelines

data.title: Scan in CI/CD
data.text: Automate scanning in your build pipeline. Fail builds on critical vulnerabilities. Don't let scans sit unused.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Patch critical and high CVEs quickly
data.takeaway: Continuous dependency scanning turns supply-chain risk into a managed process.
